authority: Kernel KERNEL_VFS owns native syscall filesystem; Vfs owns mount routing/backend handles. services/vfs_server owns a separate Vfs plus read-only FAT share and limited32-byte path IPC. Do not substitute the service namespace for kernel namespace.

layers.contract: Rust stat/open/read_dir syscall wrappers; C fstat is native24-byte subset, not POSIX struct stat.
User copies and actor/credential checks; cwd stored in shared process; global VFS mutex; scheduler released before VFS locking in fstat.
OPEN/STAT/FSTAT operations on independent VFS; special passwd/group FSTAT re-stats a path; cannot supply descriptor identity for kernel fd. AUTHORIZE_EXEC consumes kernel grants, separate authority.
tmpfs full-path exact lookup, in-memory entries/inodes/open handles; FAT adapter delegates volume path ops and native policy metadata.

resolver.contract: validate_absolute requires leading slash, rejects empty/NUL/dot/dotdot/trailing slash; repeated separators not rejected at common validation but backend exact lookup differs.
open/chdir prefix current shared-process cwd; native stat61/readdir60/148 do not. No authoritative component walk.
tmpfs looks up full path, parent validation for mutation; no common lookup of every search ancestor for reads/stat.

Fat32::stat_path walks directory components, skips repeated separators and compares case-insensitively; it does not return authoritative name spelling or enforce credentials. Common VFS validation rejects dot/dotdot before it. Reuse this backend mechanism, not a second libc walker.
overlay lstat/readlink/symlink/canonicalize explicitly unsupported; its FileType predicate alone is not symlink support.
BLOCKED: FileType only File/Directory, no link storage/readlink, no loop limit; Linux readlinkat returns EINVAL for existing entries.
Longest valid component prefix, bounded8 mounts; tagged mount incarnation and local generation handles, open handles pin mount; runtime mount target policy /mnt.

handle_path returns backend-associated name plus mount; mount prefix bug repaired. tmpfs current linked entry path, FAT open spelling; unlinked tmpfs has no name. This is not permission-checked canonicalization.
Final open read/write and readdir Read checks; no credential-aware common path resolver, native stat/chdir lack ancestor Execute checks. Actor policy protects write subtrees; do not weaken it.

namespaces: Global kernel mount namespace; no new per-process namespace introduced. Service VFS is separate; process cwd does not change mount authority.
identity: Finite generation fields reject ordinary stale handles; wrap exists. Not a permanently unique inode identity or proof against adversarial full wrap.
TOCTOU: Separate stat/open and name-based service queries race rename/unlink/mount changes. handle_path is observation, never authorization. No canonical return remains valid atomically after return.
